visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man with black hair and glasses, wearing a white button-down shirt over a white tee, sits on a grey sofa looking distressed. A digital fire animation is superimposed over the foreground. Beside him, a woman with long dark hair in a beige t-shirt smiles. The background is a brightly lit modern living room with neutral walls. Large red variety text overlays the scene. (2) A brief transition shows a color-bar test pattern, followed by a close-up shot of a small white electronic device with a blue screen, identified as an AUVON TENS unit. The woman’s hands are visible holding the device and pointing to the display. The background is out of focus but matches the indoor lighting of the room. Large teal slogan text "經痛模擬器" is centered at the top. (3) The scene returns to a medium shot of the pair sitting on the sofa. White wires are taped to their stomachs, visible under their shirts. The woman enthusiastically holds the device controller while the man looks apprehensive. The living room setting features a large grey couch and warm ambient lighting from the ceiling. White subtitles with a dark outline appear at the bottom of the frame. (4) The camera focuses on the man's facial expressions in a medium close-up as the device is activated. He winces, squints his eyes, and his mouth drops open in a pained expression. He is wearing a white shirt and grey shorts. The sofa’s textured fabric and a patterned throw pillow are visible behind him. Variety text labels "滴妹的" and "阿滴的" indicate different channels of the device. (5) A series of fast cuts shows the device screen reaching "MAX" levels and the man reacting violently to the sensation, leaning his head back against the sofa. The woman continues to operate the device, laughing and looking at him. The indoor lighting remains bright and consistent. Purple and white variety text "MAX" pulses on the screen as he shouts in mock or real agony. (6) The video shifts to a static informational graphic with a light background. It features large bold Chinese text titled "生理期造成的影響" (Impacts of the menstrual cycle). Multiple lines of text and icons are organized into categories like physical symptoms and emotional changes. There are no characters in this phase, only the graphic with detailed information. (7) The final phase shows the two individuals back on the sofa, talking calmly to the camera. The man adjusts his shirt while the woman gestures with her hands. Social media interactive overlays appear, including heart icons, a follow button, and text prompts in Chinese. The modern living room background remains unchanged with its clean, bright studio-like lighting.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a loud, pained vocalization from a male speaker, accompanied by a female's cheerful laughter. A high-tempo, upbeat comedic synthesizer background track plays consistently. A sharp "ding" sound effect triggers as variety text appears visually. The male voice is high-pitched and strained, indicating immediate distress or surprise. (2) Rapid conversational dialogue follows as the female speaker explains the "period pain simulator" project. Her voice is friendly and professional with clear articulation. Short, percussive digital "beep" sound effects occur as device buttons are pressed. The background music maintains a constant BPM, providing a playful rhythmic foundation to the speaking voices. (3) A sudden, loud shout from the male speaker marks a shift in intensity as the electrical simulation levels increase. His pitch rises dramatically, and his vocal arousal is high. The female speaker responds with more laughter and quick-paced commentary. A "whoosh" sound effect marks a transition between shots, while the BGM remains steady. (4) The audio features a series of staccato shouts and pained groans from the man, interspersed with the woman's laughing responses. The male's voice exhibits significant tension and high volume. Digital "ding" and "pop" sound effects are synchronized with text overlays like "MAX." The BGM volume swells slightly during these peak moments of the challenge. (5) The final phase consists of concluding remarks from both speakers in a more moderate conversational tone. The male voice is now calmer but still sounds slightly fatigued. A final "ding" sound effect and a rhythmic "pop" mark the call-to-action sequence. The synthesizer background music fades out gradually as the video reaches its end.
